issue_request: FHIR-42923 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core compatibility clarification asking that the cross-version extension section distinguish the FHIR version of an instance using an extension from the version where the extended element is defined, including replacing the ambiguous [version] URL placeholder with a defining-version concept and making the package table understandable.
initial_application: An older unmerged branch commit, 865786584b, attempted the issue but copied Jira markup into a malformed placeholder. The current source was applied by commit 4eaeb36c85, which changed source/versions.html to use http://hl7.org/fhir/[defining_version]/StructureDefinition/extension-[Path] and other-version instance wording. Later commit f45505e5b3 refactored the section while preserving [defining_version] and updating the explanatory line.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2024-04-01 record the 8-0-0 Persuasive vote. Related table/package decisions FHIR-42924 and FHIR-44615 are already represented on the combined branch and reinforce the current package-matrix interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active compatibility page already uses [defining_version], defines the supported defining-version list, and labels the package matrix by extension rows and package columns; searches found no remaining ambiguous [version]/extension-[Path] wording in core or the Extension Pack.
